name: omnibase/consent
description: The cookie answer of every omnibase site, in one place: a small circle, a panel, the features the visitor answers for and what each keeps, a countdown, on @glitchr/flowjs/cookie.

suggest.omnibridge/symfony: The bundle under Symfony (src/Bridge/Symfony: ConsentBundle, its configuration, the Twig extension built from the container). A Symfony site has it already: omnibase's BaseBundle refuses to start without it. A host without Symfony (Laravel, plain PHP) does not want it: ConsentPanel and Bridge\Twig\ConsentExtension need Twig and a translator only (^1.1 || ^2.0)
